I replied in the thread on Kwame's message in #coastal-team. I couldn't confirm what the Saltmarsh discount is today.

- **What the channel shows:** Bettina posted "12%" on 2025-11-17. Five minutes later she corrected it to 10%, saying she'd misread June's draft worksheet. So Kwame's memory of 12 comes from a retracted message, and 10% is the only figure in the channel.
- **Why I repeated it:** the figure was already posted in that conversation, so I could quote it back there.
- **What I couldn't check:** I can't see the Saltmarsh contract or order form, so the thread is the only evidence, and it's nearly a year old.
- **Who to ask:** Saltmarsh is Sofia's account, not Kwame's, so I didn't treat him as the account owner. I told him to confirm the current number with Sofia or June Osei-Lark on the deal desk before it goes in the renewal brief.

I didn't request approval from anyone, since I only repeated a figure already in the channel and shared nothing new.
